entities.name: Masahiko Shimada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Masahiko Shimada  is a Japanese writer. He has won the Noma Literary New Face Prize, the Izumi Kyōka Prize for Literature, the Itō Sei Literature Prize, and the Mainichi Publishing Culture Award. His work has been translated into English.
